belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that integrating into materials sustainable may influence agreement student. The evidence base (2 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: integrating into materials sustainable → [unknown mechanism] → agreement student

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of integrating into materials sustainable, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of integrating into materials sustainable on agreement student replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for integrating into materials sustainable effects on agreement student?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
